declared: 2026-10-22, after building relations/pixel maps, 5 passing synthetic contract tests and a 60-step smoke run (speed/memory only; it exposed a slow advanced-index backward, replaced by index_select with identical math: 11 s -> 0.05 s per backward), before any full SPT training or any SPT evaluation on held-out data
hypothesis: With persistent canonical surface fields + shared heads trained on ONE geometry state (T0, per-pixel random sun), a held-out rigid edit (T1: box B moved +0.44 m) is absorbed by recomputing the relation table and the incident SH state from T1 geometry, with every learned parameter bit-identical and no T1 radiance supervision.
why_more_reusable: configuration-dependent inter-surface transport enters only through the incident state g, which is recomputed from current geometry and persistent sender albedo; learned parameters see canonical position, local normal and directions. The training lights excite g (indirect light varies with the sun direction), so the operator's dependence on g is supervised without multi-configuration data.
cannot_represent: incident angular detail beyond SH order 2 (sharp glossy inter-reflections)
indirect variation finer than the 1.2 cm anchor cells
sender sun visibility finer than 512 light bins
transport changes outside the incident-state path (e.g. canonical indirect light absorbed by the direct head: leakage)
falsifiers: static representability at T0 far below RNA (rule below)
updated state does not move held-out T1 radiance toward the reference (E_stale / E_upd < 1.1 on changed surfaces)
recovery needs changes to persistent parameters (not attempted: parameters are frozen by construction; any recovery must come from state)

scene_and_data.scene: worklog-37 Diffuse Interaction Variant A (official Lego + red box B); T0 and T1 unchanged
scene_and_data.training: train_T0 (400 images, 1024 spp, per-pixel random sun; PC renders) for SPT_T0; train_T1 for SPT_T1 (= C_full only)
scene_and_data.evaluation: held-out T1 and T0 (16 views, mean of Cycles seeds 1/2 = 4096 spp; inputs from seed 1; PC renders); regions from worklog-37 eval/views.npz
scene_and_data.anchors: 184,883 (A 183,257 observed T0 surface cells of 1.2 cm, split by signed dominant normal axis; B 1,626 analytic face grid)
scene_and_data.relations: K = 128 cosine gather rays per anchor, 512 sun-direction bins; built per state by Mitsuba cuda (results/spt_lego/rel_T0/T1)

model.fields: A: triplanes 512^2 x 8 + 64^2 x 8 per plane; B: 64^2 x 8 + 16^2 x 8 (canonical frames: A dataset AABB, B box AABB +2%)
model.heads: albedo 2x64 sigmoid; direct 3x256 softplus x visibility; transfer 3x256 -> 9x3 weights, indirect = relu(sum t*g)
model.state: anchor incident cosine-weighted SH9 per light; first bounce differentiable in albedo; multi-bounce cache (4 Jacobi iterations, no gradient) refreshed every 2 epochs (training: per light bin; evaluation: exact view light)

training.machine: LabServer63 (RTX 3080 Ti); SPT_T0 and SPT_T1 concurrently; wall-clock reported, not a cost claim

arms.A_RNA: RNA_T1 on held-out T1, RNA_T0 on held-out T0 (worklog 37 eval.json; per-state supervised references)
arms.B_SO: Surface-Owned A_full, B_sel (seeds 0-2, worklogs 37-38) and frozen SO_T0 on held-out T1 (T1-supervised reconstruction except frozen)
arms.C_upd: SPT_T0 + relations(T1): the edit applied by state recomputation; no parameter change, no T1 supervision
arms.D_stale: SPT_T0 + relations(T0) on held-out T1 inputs: the factorization control (identical parameters, stale state)
arms.D_zero: SPT_T0 with g = 0 (diagnostic: what the persistent direct path carries alone)
arms.C_full: SPT_T1 trained on train_T1 + relations(T1): the candidate's own full reconstruction
arms.S_T0: SPT_T0 + relations(T0) on held-out T0 (static representability)

metrics: worklog-37 definitions: view-mean and pooled display PSNR, HDR logL1, hf |e| (top-10% reference gradient), display MSE per region (all, A_changed, A_unchanged, A_weak, A_vis_changed, A_uncorresponded, B, D*-owned, V*-owned)

outcome_rules.static: S = view-mean(S_T0) - view-mean(RNA_T0 = 33.569): credible >= -1.0 dB; weak in [-2.0, -1.0); fail < -2.0 (representability failure: the edit result is reported descriptively only)
outcome_rules.factorization_effect: F = E_stale / E_upd on A_changed (display MSE)
outcome_rules.recovery: R = (E_stale - E_upd) / (E_stale - E_full) on A_changed, E_full from C_full
outcome_rules.SUPPORTED: static credible AND F >= 1.5 AND R >= 0.7 AND W >= -0.5 dB AND SPT_T0 parameters bit-identical across C_upd / D_stale evaluation
outcome_rules.NOT_SUPPORTED: static fail OR F < 1.1 OR R < 0.3
outcome_rules.descriptive_only: comparison with RNA and Surface-Owned arms (they use T1 supervision); B-region error; costs; hf error; per-region leakage indicators (D_zero, direct/indirect split)

cost_accounting: relation rebuild per edit (gather + visibility rays, hit-to-anchor mapping), changed-anchor fraction, per-view state solve and decode, training time; oracle/physical rendering cost separately (references only, never used by C_upd)
stress: directional: synthetic contract test 4 (SH2 vs Phong n = 200, measured) and the Lego hf / changed-region errors; no near-mirror real scene in this batch
do_not_tune: model sizes, epochs, pixels per step after declaration
stop: report and stop on static fail, F < 1.1, or a violated ownership/correspondence contract; no rescue heuristics, no second architecture family
